description: Needs enableSupervisedControl and an integrated or dedicated server. Read one block at an exact position as one supervised action. Answers with outcome applied and the block, or not_applied with the reason (for example an unloaded chunk).

dimension.description: Dimension id, e.g. "minecraft:overworld", "minecraft:the_nether". Defaults to the current/overworld dimension.

name: supervised_read_block
title: Supervised block readback
